description: One category of a TmUsageMeter: what a slice of the consumption was spent on. A category explains the meter — it never replaces the headline number, which stays the component's Used parameter. The usage a category does not account for becomes an explicit localized "Other" row, so the table never silently loses a number.

members.name: Key
members.description: The programmatic key of the category — matched ORDINALLY and rendered as data-category-key, never as a DOM id (a host value is not a valid id, and a slug would collide). A category with an empty key is skipped: it could not be told apart from another one, so its usage falls into the Other row.

members.name: Label
members.description: The human-readable label, rendered as the row header of the category table. A blank label falls back to Key, so a category is never nameless for a reader.

members.name: Used
members.description: How much of the quota this category consumed, in the meter's own unit. A negative amount counts as zero for the segment, the share and the row's cell (it reads 0), while the row itself stays visible, so a host's data is never silently dropped from the table.

members.name: Color
members.description: Optional colour of the category as a CSS colour value — a var(--tm-*) token reference, a hex literal, an rgb/hsl/oklch/color-mix function, or a named colour. It is written into the segment's and the row swatch's inline background-color, so it wins over the rotating fallback token tone. A value that is not a CSS colour (a class name, or any payload carrying ;, {, } or url() emits no style and the category falls back to the rotating token tone.
